speaker: Daniel
text: Of course you have to be careful not to endanger yourself by throwing caution to the wind. Watch your back, but don’t presume the worst and be overly fearful. Be friendly with people, but watch out for those who are too friendly with you. Don’t disregard your instincts. If you hear stories about criminals on a road, you may take the road, but don’t take much cash, and don’t accept drinks from strangers.
